title: Pure Summoned Skull
summary: Pure Summoned Skull strategy uniting Yugi Muto's iconic Level 6 Normal Fiend across every extra deck mechanic: Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz. Every Summoned Skull incarnation shares its name on the field, provides protective aura effects and ATK boosts, and floats into the original Normal Monster when sent to the GY by an opponent.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fusion Deployment reveals Archfiend's Manifestation in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Summoned Skull directly from your hand or Deck without Tributes.
Advanced Ritual Art sends Level 6 Normal Monster Summoned Skull directly from your Deck to the GY to Ritual Summon Archfiend's Awakening from your hand.
Archfiend Heiress searches any Archfiend card from your Deck when sent to the GY by a card effect.
Archfiend's Advent can be Normal Summoned without tributing while you control any card, steals an opponent's monster until the End Phase on summon, and boosts your other monsters by 500 ATK.
Preparation of Rites searches Level 6 Archfiend's Awakening from your Deck and recycles Advanced Ritual Art from your GY.

summary.title: Opening: Advanced Ritual Art + Preparation of Rites
steps: Activate Preparation of Rites to search Archfiend's Awakening from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Advanced Ritual Art, sending Level 6 Normal Monster Summoned Skull from your Deck to the GY to Ritual Summon Archfiend's Awakening.
Archfiend's Awakening takes the name Summoned Skull, gains immunity to battle and non-Ritual monster effects, and boosts all Summoned Skulls to 3000 ATK.
Activate Fusion Deployment to Special Summon a second Summoned Skull directly from your Deck.
Activate Polymerization to fuse Summoned Skull with a DARK monster into Archfiend's Manifestation, or activate Makiu, the Magical Mist to wipe the opponent's monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Archfiend's Manifestation gives all Summoned Skulls you control 500 ATK, counts as Summoned Skull on the field, and Special Summons Summoned Skull from hand, Deck, or GY if sent to the GY by an opponent.
Archfiend's Awakening cannot be destroyed by battle (except by Ritual Monsters) or monster effects (except Ritual Monsters'), and floats into Summoned Skull upon leaving.
Archfiend's Call prevents the opponent from targeting any Summoned Skull you control with card effects while it is on the field, and floats into Summoned Skull if sent to the GY by an opponent.
Archfiend's Ascent gains 500 ATK by detaching 1 Xyz Material, cannot be destroyed by battle or non-Xyz monster effects, and floats into Summoned Skull if sent to the GY by an opponent.
Muckraker From the Underworld provides Link-2 recursion, discarding a card to revive Summoned Skull or any of its extra deck evolutions.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Makiu, the Magical Mist targets a Summoned Skull you control to destroy all monsters your opponent controls with DEF less than or equal to that monster's ATK, wiping whole boards.
Polymerization fuses Summoned Skull with any DARK monster to summon Archfiend's Manifestation.
Contract with the Abyss provides an alternate Ritual Spell for summoning Archfiend's Awakening using monsters in your hand or field.

main: Summoned Skull

Yugi's iconic Level 6 DARK Fiend Normal Monster (2500 ATK / 1200 DEF; always treated as an 'Archfiend' card): summoned from the Deck by Fusion Deployment, floated into from hand/Deck/GY by all 4 of its Ritual/Extra Deck evolutions, and sent from Deck to GY by Advanced Ritual Art!
Archfiend's Advent

Modern Level 6 DARK Fiend retrain (Battles of Legend: Terminal Revenge; 2500 ATK; searchable by Archfiend Heiress!): can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if you control a card; steals control of 1 monster your opponent controls until the End Phase when Normal or Special Summoned; and gives all other monsters you control +500 ATK during your turn!
Archfiend's Awakening

Signature Level 6 DARK Fiend Ritual boss (2500 ATK; searchable by Preparation of Rites and Archfiend Heiress!): its name becomes 'Summoned Skull' on the field; CANNOT be destroyed by battle (except by a Ritual Monster) or by monster effects (except Ritual Monsters'); and if this Ritual Summoned card is sent to the GY by your opponent, Special Summons 1 'Summoned Skull' from your hand, Deck, or GY!
Archfiend Heiress

Core searcher: when sent to the GY by a card effect (Fiendish Rhino Warrior, Foolish Burial, or Muckraker's discard) or destroyed by battle, adds ANY 'Archfiend' card ('Summoned Skull', 'Archfiend's Awakening', or 'Archfiend's Advent') from your Deck to your hand!
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior or Archfiend Heiress from your Deck to Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior
Sends Archfiend Heiress from your Deck to the GY when sent to the GY to search any Summoned Skull / Archfiend piece.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals 'Archfiend's Manifestation' in your Extra Deck to Special Summon 'Summoned Skull' directly from your hand or Deck with zero Tributes!
Advanced Ritual Art
Ritual Summons Level 6 'Archfiend's Awakening' from your hand by sending Level 6 Normal Monster 'Summoned Skull' directly from your Deck to the GY!
Contract with the Abyss
Ritual Summons 'Archfiend's Awakening' using monsters from your hand or field.
Preparation of Rites
Adds Level 6 Ritual Monster 'Archfiend's Awakening' from your Deck to your hand and recovers Advanced Ritual Art from your GY.
Polymerization
Fuses 'Summoned Skull' (or Archfiend's Awakening / Call / Ascent on the field!) + 1 DARK monster into 'Archfiend's Manifestation'.
Makiu, the Magical Mist

Yugi's signature Normal Spell: targets 1 'Summoned Skull' (including Awakening, Manifestation, Call, or Ascent on the field!) or Thunder monster you control and destroys ALL monsters your opponent controls with DEF less than or equal to the ATK of that monster (destroying every monster with 2500–3000 or less DEF!)!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Archfiend Heiress to the GY to search Summoned Skull, Awakening, or Advent.
extra: Signature Level 6 DARK Fiend Fusion boss ('Summoned Skull' + 1 DARK monster; 2500 ATK): its name becomes 'Summoned Skull' on the field; all 'Summoned Skull' you control (including itself, Awakening, Call, and Ascent!) gain 500 ATK (to 3000 ATK!); and if this Fusion Summoned card is sent to the GY by your opponent, Special Summons 1 'Summoned Skull' from your hand, Deck, or GY!

Signature Rank 6 DARK Fiend Xyz boss (2 Level 6 monsters—easily summoned using any two of Summoned Skull, Archfiend's Advent, Archfiend's Awakening, or Archfiend's Manifestation!; 2500 ATK): its name becomes 'Summoned Skull' on the field; if a 'Summoned Skull(s)' you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead; and floats into 'Summoned Skull' from hand, Deck, or GY if sent to the GY by your opponent!

Signature Level 6 DARK Fiend Synchro boss (2500 ATK): its name becomes 'Summoned Skull' on the field, prevents your opponent from targeting any 'Summoned Skull' you control with monster effects, and floats into Summoned Skull from hand, Deck, or GY.
Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a card (triggering Archfiend Heiress!) to revive Summoned Skull, Archfiend's Advent, or a properly summoned Awakening/Manifestation/Ascent from your GY.
